```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
# GENERATED FROM THE NOTEBOOK'S _fork.yml FILES (rule 35 keeps this block here).
#
# Three lines at most, and the last two are the forward link an append-only
# record cannot give itself. A chapter index is true as of its date and says so
# nowhere: 01 went on declaring "Sections NACA4405 and NACA0005" and "Fuselage
# neglected" long after 04 changed the sections and 02 added a fuselage, and a
# reader landing on 01 had no way to know. `supersedes:` in the LATER chapter's
# `_fork.yml` records which item it replaced, and this reads every one of them,
# so both pages carry the link and neither has to be edited to get it.
#
# `changes:` still does not print. On a chapter whose whole point is one
# decision it was the third copy of that decision on the page -- 03 said "the
# quarter chord is unswept" in the fork list, in its prose and in its
# specifications, under a title and an arrow that said it twice more.
import pathlib
import re

_HERE = "03-unswept-c4"
_LIST = re.compile(r"^supersedes:\s*$(.*?)(?=^\w|\Z)", re.M | re.S)
_ROW = re.compile(r"^\s*-\s*([0-9]{2}-[a-z0-9-]+)\s*:\s*(.+?)\s*$", re.M)


def _title(_c):
    _i = pathlib.Path("chapters") / _c / "index.qmd"
    _m = re.search(r'^title:\s*"(.+)"\s*$', _i.read_text(), re.M) \
        if _i.exists() else None
    return _m.group(1) if _m else _c


def _supersedes(_c):
    """[(replaced chapter, item)] that chapter `_c` declares it replaced."""
    _f = pathlib.Path("chapters") / _c / "_fork.yml"
    if not _f.exists():
        return []
    _b = _LIST.search(_f.read_text())
    return _ROW.findall(_b.group(1)) if _b else []


_fk = pathlib.Path(f"chapters/{_HERE}/_fork.yml")
if _fk.exists():
    _p = re.search(r"^parent:\s*(.+?)\s*$", _fk.read_text(), re.M)
    if _p:
        print(f"Forked from [{_title(_p.group(1))}](../{_p.group(1)}/).\n")

# What this chapter replaced, and what a later one replaced of its own.
_mine = [f"{_i} ([{_title(_c)}](../{_c}/))" for _c, _i in _supersedes(_HERE)]
if _mine:
    print(f"Replaces {'; '.join(_mine)}.\n")

_later = []
for _d in sorted(pathlib.Path("chapters").iterdir()):
    if not _d.is_dir() or _d.name == _HERE:
        continue
    _later += [f"{_i} — see [{_title(_d.name)}](../{_d.name}/)"
               for _c, _i in _supersedes(_d.name) if _c == _HERE]
if _later:
    print(f"Later revisited: {'; '.join(_later)}.\n")
```
